user_input: Can you help me write a resignation letter to my current employer, while leaving on good terms and expressing gratitude for the opportunities provided?
model_output:
Sure, here's a sample resignation letter that you can use as a starting point:

Dear [Employer],

I am writing to inform you that I will be resigning from my position as [Position] at [Company] effective [Date of Last Day of Work]. I want to express my sincere gratitude for the opportunities and experiences that I have had during my time at [Company].

I have truly appreciated the support and guidance that I have received from my colleagues and supervisors, and I am so grateful for the valuable skills and knowledge that I have gained during my time here. I am proud of the work that we have accomplished together and I will always look back on my time at [Company] with fond memories.

I am leaving on good terms and I am happy to assist with the transition process in any way that I can. Please let me know if there is anything specific that I can do to ensure a smooth transition.

Thank you again for the opportunity to work at [Company] and for the support and encouragement that I have received during my time here.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

Feel free to personalize this letter to fit your specific situation and needs. It's always a good idea to keep the tone of the letter professional and positive, even if you're leaving on less than ideal terms. By expressing gratitude and leaving on good terms, you can maintain a positive relationship with your former employer and coworkers, which can open up future opportunities and connections.
